notes: Audit #3 Batch 1 (v1.11.73) — the first of the 2 approved batches of the v1.11.72 full audit (93/100, 0 Critical, 0 High, 0 Medium). (1) P-102 — testbook no-op short-circuit (mirror of L14 for state): POST /api/testbook now compares the merged testbook with the stored one and skips the write + bump_seq when byte-identical (new save_testbook_if_changed + pure _compute_testbook_merge); three identical GET→POST rounds now leave the seq unchanged instead of +1 each, so a no-op save no longer forces the other open tab into a 409 + rebase + retry with a ~103KB payload. The adopt exception is preserved (an adopted save always writes + bumps, adopt → client+1); the 409 branch still returns the full testbook; the L1 seq re-read and the M2 tombstone logic are intact. (2) P-101 — the L14 × L-PERF1 interaction is documented and the repro fixed: save_state_if_changed now documents that the no-op skip removes the seq-bump side effect the L-PERF1 repro relied on, so a same-seq stale in-flight POST can land 200 and the repair path is the queue retry, not 409; the L-PERF1 repro harness now unticks with state.done["b025"] = false (the real app toggle, app.js:882) instead of delete, and passes 24/24; the L-PERF2 count check now measures the delta since the section started (a boot-time debounced save of unchanged counts fired on some runs — the same failure reproduces on the unmodified 1.11.72 tree, a pre-existing harness flake, not an app change). Option (c) — reverting the no-op skip for beacons only — was considered and DECLINED: one extra bump per pagehide is not worth re-introducing for a hole the queue already closes. (3) L21 — error toast + retry for the three user-initiated actions: reset (runResetAll: a failed/!ok POST shows toastNotSavedReason with a retry action and does NOT reload), backup-now (runBackupNow: the same toast + retry; bkNowDone only on success), clear-calendar (a failed/!ok POST shows the calError toast with a retry that re-clicks the button and re-confirms, and skips invalidateCalStatus + renderCalendarPanel). Only these three sites — the other 16 empty catches are untouched. (4) L23 — load_seq now calls _preserve_corrupt(SEQ_FILE) when seq.json exists but is unparseable (same BUG-009 pattern as the other stores), then rewrites it with zeros so the next load does not re-preserve the same bytes; a missing file is still first run, not corruption. The seq-before-state-write reorder is IMPLEMENTED (save_state bumps the counter BEFORE the state write — a crash between the two atomic writes leaves the counter one generation ahead, the safe direction: stale clients 409 and rebase onto identical state) and is pinned by the proof test (simulated crash between bump and write: counter advanced exactly 1, stored state unchanged, old-seq POST 409s, new-seq POST 200s). (5) L11 — backup restore now calls _preserve_corrupt(target) instead of the inline second-precision copy, so two restores in the same second preserve TWO corrupt copies instead of overwriting the first. (6) L12 — minutesBetween validates both sides with an HH:MM regex first and returns 0 when either side is invalid: minutesBetween("xx","11:00") = 0 (was 660), ("10:00","xx:yy") = 0 (was 840), ("25:99","11:00") = 0 (was 501); valid pairs unchanged including the overnight wrap "23:00"→"01:00" = 120 and null→null = 0; the v1.11.60 comment claiming garbage could only yield 0 is corrected. Nothing deferred. i18n 1441/1441 (no new keys — L21 reuses existing toasts). Batch 2 (v1.11.74) starts after this version is published.
